plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=14)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot with regression line to explore the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.regplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', data=data, 
                            scatter_kws={'alpha':0.5}, line_kws={'color':'red'})

# Customize the plot with titles and labels
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
